description: Remove the caller's own rating from a public Thalovant hub and return the hub. This clears only the caller's rating, not the hub. Requires the hubs:write scope; no paid plan is needed.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

name: thalovant_clear_hub_rating
title: Clear Hub Rating
